linguistic_source.role: Independent lexical evidence. Generated strings and their dictionary glosses are NOT translations.

phonetic_experiment_scope.coverage_filter: forty most frequent strict-seal signs plus fish family
phonetic_experiment_scope.strong_assumption: One eligible inscription corresponds to one dictionary headword.
phonetic_experiment_scope.evaluation: retrospective held-expression partitions, not independent archaeological samples or a blind discovery test
phonetic_experiment_scope.metric: exact syllabified dictionary-headword matches; not sound or translation accuracy

comparability.first_two_runs: Different partitions; do not report their difference as a controlled improvement.
comparability.four_vowel_runs: Same training and held parse-equivalence partition.

new_model_hypothesis.idea: The graphical fish square may encode vowel quality and vowel quantity rather than two fish-name modifiers.
new_model_hypothesis.important_limit: No example vowel, onset, sound assignment, syllabary, linguistic identity, or script ancestry is established.

nonfish_candidate.status: contextual alternation; synonymy and literal graphical decomposition unproved
nonfish_candidate.limit: Both contexts share one phrase family; not independent lexical confirmations.

counterfield_observation.source_checked: Vats, Excavations at Harappa, volumeII, plateXCVI, objects448/452; held PDF index199.
counterfield_observation.observed: Cup and fish-shaped sign switch positions relative to the four strokes. Not a global reversal of the three catalogue signs.
limits: H-912/H-1191 share an excavation reference; not independent samples.
